title: 《AICSO AI安全官白皮书》
summary: AICSO 人工智能安全官社区编制的 AI 安全官能力框架（V1.0），从 AI 安全官定义、个人能力、技术体系、治理合规和组织建设等维度，回答 AI 深度进入企业后该如何开展 AI 安全治理。公开文档，CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
title_en: AICSO AI Security Officer White Paper
summary_en: The AI Security Officer Competency Framework (AICSO-CF V1.0) from the AICSO community — what an AI security officer is, the skills, technical stack, governance and compliance, and organization needed to run AI security once AI is deeply embedded in an enterprise. Open document, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
